g.text: Five classes connect tools to trusted data
07 / CODE BOUNDARIES In-process calls and private HTTP requests are different relationships.
No arbitrary URL or actuation tool.
Pinned CPU encoder; two Torch threads.
Versioned Feast registry + embedded Milvus Lite
Rank IDs, resolve singleton records, check source-bound text
Validate schema, clocks, lease and pin
The five named classes are actual implementations. FeastKServeBackend is their injected backend dependency.
MCP calls the two private APIs; it does not instantiate their runtime classes in its own process.
PSI describes input drift, not measured model-accuracy loss. Movement illustrates direction, not execution order.
D1 Rank IDs; resolve exact passages
